summary: A dataset produced by the Engine, a formula, or a method can now have the way it is shown changed and saved, even though its values still cannot be edited.
details: Origin Length, Development Length, Cumulative, Development/Calendar, Transposed, the subtotal row, Number Format, Decimal Places, and Notes all save on these datasets.
Such a save touches nothing but the dataset's settings file and refreshes no dependent object, so it finishes immediately.
The status line no longer shows the note about writing values into the stored period on a dataset whose cells cannot be typed into.
